generated.details: In the far-right background against the wall, the partly right-cropped cream-painted low sideboard has a rectangular carcass, inset closed doors and short supporting feet.
On its visible top, the closed unlabelled household folder has two plain buff card covers joined by a folded spine.
Beside it, the reading glasses have two clear lenses joined by a bridge, with hinged temples folded inward.
Their gathered headers hang from a rod, forming relaxed vertical folds with stitched hems.
